principle: Restore an r32 move when a direct classic semantic exists. For modern semantic families, preserve the modern gameplay/state structure while expressing the visible blade/saya motion with r32 motion language. Shared atlas regions must use one compatible compromise because a resource pack cannot branch on runtime ComboState.

policies.CLASSIC_RESTORATION: Direct r32 move family sampled into a compatible modern window. Timing or mesh differences may still make the result REMAP/APPROXIMATE rather than exact.
policies.SHARED_SLOT_INTERPRETATION: Modern semantic family shares two or more VMD frames with another move family, so one classic-style motion must serve all consumers.
policies.INDEPENDENT_INTERPRETATION: Modern semantic family owns a dedicated VMD region and can receive a purpose-built classic-style sequence without changing another move family.
policies.JAVA_ONLY: Behavior is selected or executed by runtime Java and cannot be independently restored by an ordinary resource pack.

families.name: sakura_right_ground
families.reason: The Sakura ground sequence occupies the A3 atlas region, so it cannot receive a separate resource-only clip.

families.name: sakura_left_ground
families.reason: The Sakura-left window is the same landing region used by Aerial Cleave.

families.name: sakura_right_air
families.reason: The airborne Sakura-right sequence exactly reuses the Aerial A2 atlas family.

families.name: sakura_left_air
families.reason: The airborne Sakura-left attack reuses Aerial A3 frames.

families.name: drive_horizontal
families.reason: Drive Horizontal consumes the same complete atlas region as Combo C.

families.name: drive_vertical
families.reason: Drive Vertical is a second semantic consumer of the Upper Slash atlas family.

families.name: wave_edge_vertical
families.reason: Wave Edge Vertical starts from the same Upper/Drive Vertical motion region; projectile behavior remains Java-driven.

families.name: void_slash
families.reason: Frames 2200-2299 are a dedicated modern family. The attack keeps SlashDim-like compression while the separate modern sheath state is interpreted with a short classic Noutou gesture.
